old_problem: The active review treated the source's non-zero/equal-column rule as usable once project parameters were supplied, but no authoritative AMDXIO schema or build-specific interpretation was cited. Direct AMD documentation now shows that margin status can transiently read zero on affected platforms and that a known retimer margin issue requires stepthrough mode, so the source oracle cannot be generalized safely.
disposition_reason: This is not merely a missing BDF. The proprietary AMDXIO command semantics, receiver=6 applicability, output schema, zero-value handling, same-column equality rule, known-issue workaround and exact ASPM restore sequence depend on the approved platform/tool release. AMD errata explicitly warns that lane-margin status may be incorrectly zero for a clock and should be reread, while another AMD release note directs stepthrough mode for a zero retimer result. ED-03 cannot parameterize an unknown authoritative PASS/FAIL oracle; ED-15 forbids PASS without it, and ED-16/ED-17 require safe disruptive-tool and recovery approval. Pending is therefore retained rather than fabricating correctness.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row403 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2995 and both same-code row403/404 variants.
Preserved this variant's endpoint receiver=6, eight OAM links, ASPM L0s/L1 control, BER/error/range parameters and complete lane CSV coverage separately from row404 retimer receiver=2/3.

AMD Family 19h errata states lane-margin status fields may transiently read zero under specified conditions and recommends ignoring/re-reading invalid all-zero data; therefore `any zero = fail` is not universally authoritative.
AMD release notes identify a retimer margin zero-value issue whose workaround is AMDXIO stepthrough mode, proving tool-build/platform behavior affects the command and oracle.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row404 and verified its manifest identity; no AMDXIO, ASPM, margin or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Eight-link AMD OAM endpoint receiver-6 PCIe four-point margin characterization
test_case.purpose: Characterize all lanes of each mapped AMD OAM endpoint PCIe link at receiver 6 with the approved AMDXIO four-point profile, while preserving exact target identity, ASPM state and complete per-lane evidence.
required_package: AMD-approved AMDXIO build, checksum, license, release notes and exact command/output-schema documentation for the platform
Eight OAM serial/end-point BDF/upstream-bridge/receiver/lane maps validated from current topology
Approved receiver=6 support and BER=10, errcnt=5, four-point phase/voltage range semantics for this build
Authoritative CSV column definitions, expected lane-row rules, zero/re-read/stepthrough handling and numeric PASS/FAIL thresholds
Per-bridge ASPM L0s/L1 pre-state, ordered disable/restore method, maintenance isolation, AER/link/thermal monitoring and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: NOT RELEASED FOR EXECUTION. After the missing AMD/project authority is supplied, attest each current endpoint and upstream bridge, capture ASPM/link/AER/thermal pre-state, disable only the approved bridge L0s/L1 controls in the documented order, and run the signed AMDXIO receiver=6 four-point profile one link at a time. Preserve complete stdout/stderr and original CSV, apply the approved invalid-zero/re-read/stepthrough rule, then restore and verify the exact ASPM state before advancing.
test_case.expected_result: For every approved endpoint and every expected lane, the tool completes under the signed build-specific procedure, output schema and receiver mapping; lane completeness and margin/error values satisfy the approved numeric and invalid-sample rules; no disallowed AER/link/GPU/thermal event occurs; and every upstream bridge returns to its exact original ASPM state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PENDING AUTHORITY. PASS must not be assigned until AMD/project owners approve the exact AMDXIO build, receiver=6 semantics, CSV schema, numeric thresholds, treatment of zero/equal values and any stepthrough/re-read rule. Row count alone, generic non-zero checks or assumed column equality are insufficient.
safety_gate: Do not execute without signed AMDXIO provenance, exact live topology and build-specific receiver/output documentation
Never reuse example BDFs; bind endpoint and upstream bridge identities from current topology
Capture exact ASPM pre-state and prove a tested ordered restore procedure before disabling L0s/L1
Run one isolated link at a time with independent management and live AER/link/GPU/thermal monitoring
Stop on mapping/schema ambiguity, link degradation, AER escalation, thermal event or failed ASPM restoration; never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Approved AMDXIO binary/checksum/license/release notes and receiver=6 command/schema authority
Eight-link endpoint/bridge/receiver/lane map and pre-state ASPM/link/AER/thermal evidence
Exact signed commands plus complete stdout/stderr and original per-link CSVs
Per-lane parser output applying approved zero/re-read/stepthrough and numeric margin rules
Post-link AER/GPU/thermal health and exact ASPM restoration diff for every bridge
test_case.recovery: If a target, schema, link or margin anomaly occurs, stop all remaining links, restore the captured ASPM settings on the affected upstream/downstream components in the approved order, verify original link rate/width and GPU health through OOB, preserve raw data and escalate. Do not rerun or reinterpret zero values without the missing authority.
